why: An Internal-class title is a system-generated machine translation (operator, 2026-09-30) and must take part in title comparison at a discount, never be ignored: normalized-record.md section 4.1, ratified 2026-07-29, closing section 7 gap 1. Raised by LanguageTool (HANDOFF-FROM-LANGUAGETOOL-2026-09-30-internal-titles-still-excluded-from-comparison): about 450,000 Internal titles registry-wide (11% of a 2% mirror sample), mostly English translations of non-English titles, and often the ONLY English on a French-registered record, so excluding them removes the one title that could agree. Here the submission is registered in French with an Internal English translation; the candidate is registered under that English title; same year, same director. Up to compare-spec 2.17.0 the translation is dropped, only 'Le Grand Voyage' vs 'The Great Journey' is compared (title 0.48), and this fixture FAILS -- which is why it waits in golden_pairs_pending/. Split as T3 was: eidr-core 0.40.0 ships the mechanism inert; BMR-Review adds INTERNAL_TITLE_DISCOUNT to config.py, measures, and the compare-spec version that lands the knob moves this file into golden_pairs/ with its regen. Invariants are value-independent: the title reaches 0.5 through the discounted translation (any discount of 0.5 or more), and the pair is not rejected. SCOPE: Basic, cross-language, one Internal title on the submitted side; it does not pin the discount's value, the one-sided fallback case, or part-number interaction.
